full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media horror illustration shows a gaunt human-like face looming over an open book, with a long-eared creature pressed close at the right. The background is almost black, broken by rubbed blue-gray and rust-colored patches that make the space feel shallow and uncertain. The pale face occupies the center of the upper half. One eye is ringed in icy gray, the other catches a small amber glow, and dense scratching radiates across the forehead and cheeks. Dark hollows cut beneath the eyes and around the nose, while the mouth is held in a tense downward shape. At the right edge, the narrow animal-like head rises into view, its pointed ear and long muzzle built from pinkish brown strokes over blue-black shadow. Two smaller framed faces crowd the left margin, one high near the corner and another below it, adding a compressed, haunted rhythm without forming a separate scene. Across the lower third, an open book spreads toward both sides. Cream and yellow pages bend around a dark central fold, with short dark marks suggesting printed lines rather than clearly readable words. Heavy black contours anchor the book and faces, but colored chalk-like scratches and scraped paint disrupt their surfaces. A cold diffuse light seems to strike the central face and paper from the front, while amber touches on the pages and eyes give the darkness a feverish warmth. The surrounding forms fade into gritty shadow rather than a measured room. The overall composition presses pale faces and luminous paper into a dense blue-black field, producing a restless, uncanny mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形混合媒介恐怖插画描绘一张消瘦、近似人类的面孔俯临一本摊开的书，右侧有一只长耳生物紧贴其旁。背景几乎全黑，被擦出的蓝灰和锈色斑块打断，让空间显得浅而难辨。浅色面孔占据上半幅中央。一只眼睛笼在冰冷灰色中，另一只眼里有小小的琥珀色光点，密集的刮擦线从额头和脸颊向外辐射。眼下和鼻周是深色凹处，嘴向下绷紧。右侧画边，狭长的兽类头部伸入画面，尖耳与长吻由蓝黑阴影上的粉棕色笔触构成。两张较小、被框住的脸挤在左侧边缘，一张靠近上角，另一张在其下方，为画面加入压迫而幽灵般的节奏，却没有形成另一个独立场景。下三分之一处，一本打开的书向两侧铺展。奶油色与黄色书页围绕深色中缝弯曲，短小暗痕暗示印刷行列，却不是能清楚辨认的文字。沉重黑色轮廓固定书与面孔，但彩色粉笔般的刮痕和刮擦颜料破坏了表面。冷而漫射的光似乎从正面照到中央面孔和纸页，书页与眼中的琥珀色触点又给黑暗添上躁热的暖意。周围形体消失在粗粝阴影里，而非可测量的房间。整体构图把浅色面孔和发亮纸张压进浓密蓝黑色域，形成焦躁而诡异的情绪。
style_prompt_en: Mixed-media illustration layers heavy dark drawing, scraped pigment, and chalk-like colored strokes over a rough surface. Blue-black and charcoal masses carry most of the frame, while dirty ivory, rust, muted violet, and small amber accents pull selected forms forward. Crosshatching and scratch lines make even lit areas uneasy; edges are alternately incised and rubbed into shadow. Light is concentrated on a few pale planes, leaving surrounding shapes compressed and partly unresolved. Dense details cluster near the focal area, then break apart into gritty negative space. The result is tactile, claustrophobic, and uncanny.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介插画在粗糙底面上叠加沉重暗色线描、刮擦颜料和粉笔般的彩色笔触。蓝黑与炭灰色团占据画面大部，脏象牙色、铁锈色、柔紫和少量琥珀色强调将局部形体推向前方。交叉排线与刮痕使受光区域也显得不安；边缘时而刻得尖锐，时而被摩擦进阴影。光集中在少数浅色平面，周围形体则压缩且部分未被明确刻画。密集细节聚向焦点，随后碎裂为粗粝的负空间。整体可触、逼仄而诡异。
theme_en: A gaunt face emerging above an open book beside a long-eared creature
theme_zh: 一张消瘦的面孔在摊开的书上方浮现，旁有长耳生物
name: Clive Barker
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
